description: Get Debtor Due Amount Report. Part of the Due Amount Report APIs in Giddh. Requires Auth-Key or Session-Id.

count.description: Page size (number of items returned). Default: 20.

sort.description: Sort direction. Allowed values: asc, desc. Default: asc.

sortBy.description: Field name to sort by. Default: name.

q.description: Search text (case sensitivity depends on the endpoint).

branchUniqueName.description: Branch uniqueName; omit for default company branch behaviour.

vendorCustomerType.description: Vendor customer type query parameter. Default: CUSTOMER.

totalDueAmountEqualTo.description: When true, applies the total due amount equal to filter or flag.

totalDueAmountNotEqualTo.description: When true, applies the total due amount not equal to filter or flag.
